reason: A dsh web interface plugin centered on a replacement five-column layout with right-side workspace navigation, Git source control, file previews, and a multi-session terminal dock; human review is warranted because it exposes shell sessions and repository mutations.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh web 提供五栏界面、右侧工作区文件浏览与预览、Git 源代码管理面板以及多会话终端停靠栏。
summaries.en: Provides dsh web with a five-column interface, right-side workspace file browsing and previews, Git source control, and a multi-session terminal dock.

capabilities: replaces the built-in web layout with a five-column frame
displays workspace files with Git status and content or diff previews
reads Git status and performs stage, unstage, and commit operations
creates PTY terminal sessions and forwards shell input and output
